{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Obama and the Democratic Party are committed to keeping a trust with troops, military families, and veterans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Troops, military families, and veterans have borne the burden of war and have made the military the best in the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support will continue for troops in the field.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support will continue for wounded warriors, mental health, and the well-being of military families and veterans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Work will continue to give veterans health care, benefits, education, and job opportunities they have earned.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President and the Democratic Party supported the Post-9/11 G.I. Bill to provide opportunities for military personnel, veterans, and their families to get a better education.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President is working to ensure returning veterans are able to get good jobs and put their skills to good use at home.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President launched partnerships with the private sector to help veterans transfer their experience into skilled manufacturing jobs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President proposed a new Veterans Jobs Corps to put veterans to work as first responders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President signed an executive order making it harder for for-profit colleges to prey on veterans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Returning Heroes Tax Credit and the Wounded Warrior Tax Credit were enacted to give companies incentives to hire veterans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
